supersedes_diagnostic_versions.v1: identity-key mismatch made outcome join coverage invalid
supersedes_diagnostic_versions.v2: candidate pool restricted to immediately previous round and missed most target participants
supersedes_diagnostic_versions.v4: deterministic every-third-round sample; V5 evaluates all high-confidence rounds

candidate_policy: For target round r, each candidate's latest observed row strictly before r is carried forward. CR, role and team are therefore lagged; when a player has no row in r-1, the last observed CR is carried forward because no intervening appearance was recorded. Current target-round PDK is used only as realized outcome. This expands coverage beyond players who appeared in r-1 but still excludes players who have never appeared in the archived season.

target_date_mapping.mapping_method: Official-valid Dunkest PDK and player/team identity are used only to link historical outcome rows to candidate NBA dates. A round date is accepted only if >=75% of unique player-date links agree and >=10 unique links exist. Matchup features use NBA schedule and opponent defensive stats strictly before that date.

coach_policy: Historical coach CR is missing; use fixed coach_cr=10 for every team, and reconstruct neutral-credit base score from final NBA results. Coach budget and price-difference multipliers are therefore proxies, not historical market truth.

optimizer.formation: 4G/4F/2C roster; 5 starters, sixth man, 4 bench; one captain; max 3 per NBA team including coach
optimizer.reason: Historical carry-over roster and exact transfer/coach prices are not archived; this evaluates fresh independent round lineups.

fold_policy: Train player score model on earlier valid seasons only; test seasons 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25. No test-season labels are used to fit its model. All high-confidence mapped rounds with a prior historical candidate pool are evaluated; CBC uses a 1-second time limit and 5% relative gap.
limitations: This is a restricted-universe lineup experiment, not a complete historical Dunkest market backtest. The candidate universe contains only players observed in the prior archived round; late additions and players absent from that round may be missing.

The historical round archives are outcomes, not timestamped complete pre-lock roster snapshots. Candidate coverage is reported; results must not be generalized to the full market without complete roster archives.

Missing target-round player rows are scored as zero only within this restricted experiment; this assumes absence from the official-valid round table means no fantasy points for that player in the round.
Historical coach prices and exact credit-difference multipliers are unavailable; coach CR is fixed at 10 and neutral-credit base scores are used.
No transfer malus is applied because historical carry-over rosters and coach prices are unavailable.
